name: Spokojnoj nochi
source:
Maria has been suffering from insomnia for a long time. What can she do to finally go into a long-awaited sleep? And why does it seem like there is someone else in the house besides her? Is she asleep or not, and if she is - will she be able to wake up? Why does the world around her seem to be giving her signs that... there's something wrong with her? Or maybe it's just a dream?

[Translated from [url=https://vkplay.ru/play/game/spokojnoj_nochi/]VK play[/url]]
